title: Lenny chart values
description: JSON Schema for the Helm values of the Lenny chart. Enforced at install-time by helm install / helm upgrade / helm install --dry-run; the layer-3 startup gate in pkg/gateway/playground.Config.Validate is the runtime backstop.

enabled.description: §27.2 playground.enabled — mount /playground/* and /v1/playground/token on the gateway.

authMode.description: §27.2 playground.authMode — one of oidc, apiKey, dev.

devTenantId.description: §27.2 playground.devTenantId — the tenant bound to dev-mode playground tokens. Required when authMode=dev; must match the canonical §10.2 tenant_id format.

allowedRuntimes.description: §27.2 playground.allowedRuntimes — comma-separated glob list of runtime IDs visible in the picker.

maxSessionMinutes.description: §27.6 playground.maxSessionMinutes — hard cap on session duration.

oidcSessionTtlSeconds.description: §27.3.1 playground.oidcSessionTtlSeconds — server-side session and cookie lifetime.

bearerTtlSeconds.description: §27.3.1 playground.bearerTtlSeconds — MCP bearer token TTL. Gateway bounds to 60..3600.

gatewayHost.description: §27.7 playground.gatewayHost — public host interpolated into the connect-src CSP directive.

sessionLabels.description: §27.2 line 41 playground.sessionLabels — operator-tunable label map stamped on every playground session record and audit event. The origin entry is re-stamped to "playground" at startup.

acknowledgeApiKeyMode.description: §27.2 line 42 playground.acknowledgeApiKeyMode — acknowledge the §27.9 paste-form phishing surface for authMode=apiKey outside dev mode.
